title: Stabilize autoscaling by hardening probes and load-shedding to meet runtime SLOs
creator: Sofia Patel
description:
Problem: In the last two quarters we've observed autoscaler-induced instability during traffic spikes and region failovers. Symptoms include rapid instance churn, prolonged cold-start latency for certain model families, and transient SLO breaches on 99th percentile latency. Root causes identified so far: (1) liveness probes that only check process health but not model KV cache warm state, causing instances to be marked Ready before they can serve low-latency requests; (2) readiness probes that are too strict/too slow and flip during short GC or kernel loading events; (3) autoscaler reacts to pod Ready state and CPU without weighting request queue/backpressure signals, leading to oscillation; (4) lack of graceful load-shedding/circuit breaker logic when queue depth grows during multi-region failover.

Goal: Make autoscaling stable and ensure we meet runtime SLOs during spikes and region failovers by (A) improving readiness/liveness probes to reflect runtime-serving readiness (KV cache primed, model loaded, warmup tokens processed), (B) introducing an in-pod circuit breaker and progressive load-shedding policy to avoid cascading overload, and (C) adding autoscaler stability rules (rate-limited scale steps, cooldowns, and signal fusion that includes request latency, queue depth, and pod readiness) plus canary-rollout plan for changes.

Proposed approach:
- Health checks:
  - Replace current liveness probe with a two-stage check: (i) process/worker health (existing), (ii) lightweight in-memory KV cache signature that verifies last N-sequence cache entries are accessible. Liveness still fails fast if process threads die.
  - Replace readiness probe with a composite readiness: model artifact present + tokenized warmup ping succeeded within 100ms for small warmup sample + network connectivity check to storage/backend. Readiness will only return Ready after model warming completes.
- Probe tuning:
  - Increase readiness initialDelaySeconds to 20s, periodSeconds to 5s, failureThreshold to 3 for models with >2GB footprint; lighter models keep defaults.
  - Add probe-type labels per model profile and make probe params configurable via CRD/ConfigMap so ops can adjust without redeploy.
- Autoscaler stability:
  - Modify scaler to fuse signals: target = weighted( p99_latency, queue_length, RPS, pod_ready_fraction ). Default weights: p99_latency=0.5, queue_length=0.3, pod_ready_fraction=0.2.
  - Rate-limit scale-out to max 3 pods per minute per zone, scale-in cooldown 5 minutes after successful scale-out.
  - Use exponential backoff for repeated scale-outs triggered within a 10-minute window to avoid step-chasing.
- Circuit breakers and load-shedding:
  - Implement per-route circuit breaker: if p99_latency > 1.5x SLO and queue_depth > threshold, reject low-priority requests with HTTP 429 and return structured body describing degradation (include retry-after and recommended alternate region).
  - Implement priority tiers (critical, standard, background) and enforce shedding order.
- Multi-region behavior:
  - During region failover, incorporate cross-region capacity signals: if region A is draining, increase scale-out allowance in region B with a higher weight but apply stricter load-shedding thresholds to protect p99 latencies.
- Observability and rollout:
  - Add dashboards: probe_success_rate, probe_latency, pod_ready_fraction, autoscaler_decisions, scale_events, shed_count_by_route, circuit_breaker_trips.
  - Alerts: probe_failure_rate > 1% for 5m (P1), repeated scale churn > 10 events/10m (P0), shedding_rate > 2% and p99_latency > SLO (P0).

Backwards compatibility: Default behavior preserved for clusters without runtime-1.21 rollout flag. Feature is gated behind remote feature flag "stable-autoscale-probes". Gradual rollout plan described below.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Readiness probe change reduces premature Ready flips: <1 premature-Ready incident per week in canary cluster over 7 days
2) Autoscaler oscillation metric (scale events per 30m) reduced by >=60% in canary under synthetic spike tests
3) End-to-end p99 latency meets SLO during 2x synthetic traffic spike in canary and 1.5x during scheduled multi-region failover
4) Load-shedding triggers correctly by priority tier and returns HTTP 429 with structured error payload; clients see retry-after header
5) No customer-facing errors during a staged rollout to 20% of clusters; rollbacks possible via feature flag within 10 minutes
6) Dashboards and alerts emit meaningful signals for ops, and runbook updated with playbook steps for probe, autoscaler, and circuit-breaker incidents
comments: 2026-02-13 Sofia Patel: Spun up hypothesis doc and initial probe tests. Observed that warmup ping time is correlated with p99 latency spikes during cold-start windows. Added detailed probe plan.

2026-02-20 Marcus Lee: Implemented probe composite endpoint in runtime: /health/ready-v2. See PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1234 - initial unit tests passing; integration tests failing intermittently due to CI VM performance variance.

2026-02-25 QA: Synthetic spike test harness (k6) shows autoscaler chasing traffic in us-west-2: 28 scale events in 30m baseline. Proposed short-term mitigation: temporarily increase target threshold and add 2m cooldown via config. Ticket ENG-4888 tracks quick mitigation.

2026-03-02 Infra review (A. Miller): Recommend configuration via ConfigMap and default conservative values. Concern raised re: cloud provider rate-limits and max pod concurrency; we should validate with Dedicated clusters.

2026-03-05 Marcus Lee: Circuit breaker MVP implemented behind flag. PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1278. Added unit tests for priority-based shedding. Needs load test validation.
2026-03-09 Perf: Run k6 against canary (10% traffic); p99 improved from 1.8s to 1.1s during synthetic spike, scale churn down 65%. Will proceed to 20% if no regressions in 72h.
2026-03-11 PM review (L. Chen): Request adding consumer-facing error schema for 429s and update SDK docs. Added follow-up task ENG-4942 to update SDKs and client retries.

2026-03-13 Marcus Lee: Merged probe tuning and autoscaler fusion algorithm to canary branch, enabling feature flag for 20% rollout. Created dashboards: runtime/autoscaler/decision_log and runtime/probes/ready_rate. Monitoring runbook drafted at https://confluence.redwood.com/display/OPS/Autoscaler+Stability+Runbook
